data.title: Binance Completes Perlin Lottery Draw and Will Open Trading For PERL
data.body:
Fellow Binancians,

Binance has completed the Perlin lottery draw, with a 5.46% ratio of winning tickets. The results of the lottery draw and airdrop are summarized below.

No. of Digits

Tail Digits Drawn in the Lottery

No. of Winning Tickets

None

228688

1
 

Total 

13,400

 

Binance will also open trading for PERL/BNB, PERL/BTC, PERL/USDT  and PERL/USDC trading pairs at 2019/08/26 12:00 PM (UTC).

Perlin Listing Fee: 0 BNB.

Note:

  • Please ensure that you have sufficient BNB in your account based on the number of your winning tickets. Users will have 24 hours until 2019/08/26 08:00 AM (UTC) to credit their normal exchange accounts with BNB, at which point the distribution of PERL will be complete. Please note that BNB in open orders or in margin accounts will not be able to be deducted. 
  • The token purchase price was set at 1 PERL = 0.00287844 BNB/0.07743 USD (using a BNB price of 26.90 USD) as per the previous announcement here.
  • The Perlin (PERL) ERC20 token smart contract is available on the explorer here: https://etherscan.io/token/0xb5a73f5fc8bbdbce59bfd01ca8d35062e0dad801 

3,874,500 PERL Airdrop Results

For this Launchpad session, a pool of 3,874,500 PERL tokens will be split and airdropped to all launchpad participants that did not have a winning ticket. 

The amount airdropped to each participant that did not have a winning ticket has been calculated as = (Number of non-winning tickets held by each non-winning participant / Total number of non-winning tickets across all non-winning participants) x Total Airdrop Pool. Please note that if you do have a winning ticket, you will not be eligible for the airdrop. 

Based on the Perlin Launchpad lottery results, the total number of tickets claimed by the 29,755 non-winning participants was 158,762. As such, the number of PERL airdropped for each ticket claimed by a non-winning participant will be 24.40445446 PERL.

Thanks for your support!

Binance Team
